description_en: Query Configuration of Website Business Forwarding Rules
description_zh: 查询网站业务转发规则的配置
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-web-rules --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --domain example.com --cname kzmk7b8tt3510000.aliyunddos10140000 --query-domain-pattern exact --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --instance-ids ddoscoo-cn-i7m27nf30000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeWebRules

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID of the DDoS protection instance in the resource management service.

Not setting this parameter indicates the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website to query.

The domain must have been configured with website business forwarding rules. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~DescribeDomains~~) to query all domains that have been configured with website business forwarding rules
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的网站域名。

域名必须已经配置过网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有已经配置过网站业务转发规则的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The query matching pattern. Values:
fuzzy (default): Indicates fuzzy query.
exact: Indicates exact query
parameters.help_zh:
查询匹配模式。取值：
fuzzy（默认）：表示模糊查询。
exact：表示精确查询
parameters.name: query_domain_pattern

parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含转发规则的数量。取值范围：1~10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The list of DDoS protection instance IDs to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID列表
parameters.name: instance_ids
